name: Nearest Neighbour Interpolation for Voxelization
definition: A method to assign attribute values to voxel centers by finding the closest point in the original point cloud to each voxel center using a KDTree, rather than averaging points within the voxel volume.
summary: Nearest Neighbour Interpolation for Voxelization assigns voxel attributes by selecting the single closest point in a point cloud, distinguishing it from histogramming methods that aggregate all points within a voxel.
